name: gemini-plan-review
description: Gemini reviews each plan before the approval dialog, with the conversation, and sends a plan with a blocking finding back to the model, at most twice. /gemini-plan-review turns it on or off; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level. Needs function hooks (early access).

maxInputChars.title: Maximum characters of conversation sent to Gemini
maxInputChars.description: Above it the longest tool outputs of the conversation are cut to their head and tail before sending. The plan is always sent whole.
